name: Alter Self
desc: You alter your physical form. Choose one option: Aquatic Adaptation (gills and webbing: breathe underwater, Swim Speed equal to your Speed), Change Appearance (alter your look, size and build within your type), or Natural Weapons (claws, fangs, horns or hooves: an Unarmed Strike deals 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage, using your spellcasting ability for the attack roll). As a Magic action you can switch options. Concentration, up to 1 hour.
